quotes.text: Apple can't see a future where the Mac isn't like the iPhone: a 30% cut of all software revenue, a 30% cut of any AI tokens you use, and 30% of your time as a developer developing for your own account.
quotes.author: PaulHoule
quotes.source: Hacker News — Apple and a Hacker's Future
quotes.extraction_note: The '30%' refrain turns platform-enshittification critique into a genuinely memorable line. Collapsed the run-on original into one clean sentence, kept all three escalating cuts.
